scope: Existing authorized training/internal-development records and six internal-dev mask planes; no MRI intensity load, no reserved-patient images/outcomes, no model

label_families.sequence: Source acquisition identity, independent of tumor mask
label_families.spatial: Source-reviewed segmentation projected centroid in FLAIR panel
label_families.dependency_correction: Three tumor routes share a mask; sequence does not. Four routes are not four independent biomedical skills.

minimal_concrete_common_patient_candidat.selection_rule: Retain the existing frozen21 C training grid rows. Select both existing single-sequence images of exactly the same patient and axial level. Apply unchanged >=1000 tumor pixels and >=10 display-pixel grid-boundary filters to the six original internal-dev grid rows, and select both corresponding sequence rows for each retained patient-level. Do not alter original382/54 manifests or A/B controls.

primary_scientific_blockers: Existing C contract explicitly requires qualified blind assessment that source-defined tumor extent/centroid is recoverable from unoverlaid inputs; no such assessment exists. Do not invent clinical admission.
The spatial reward is exact categorical 3x3 projected-mask-centroid agreement, not 2D IoU,3D grounding or anatomical laterality.
Selected21 training labels cover5of9 grid cells;3 development rows cover2cells. Cohort is small and development patients have already been examined. No confirmatory generalization claim.
A new C subset is separate from B sequence-exposure control; any full-arm budget/initialization/evaluation freeze is still needed.
